card.name: Unit before a squared exponent
card.fires_on: The unit letter or symbol right before a superscript 2 (or other exponent), as in cm², m² in kg/m² or mL/min/1.73 m². It also fires on the base before an exponent in formulas.

modes.label: Area units before 2
modes.description: The m or cm of an area or body-surface unit, just before the superscript 2.

modes.label: Exponents in formulas
modes.description: A variable or number in a math formula that is about to take an exponent.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward ending the unit and moving on, and away from exponent or power words.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a unit like m or cm is about to be squared, as in BMI or kidney-function units.
